dedupe_keys.name: supplemental material for experimental characterization and hysteretic modeling of inter modular connections for volumetric clt buildings

description: Supplemental Material for Experimental Characterization and Hysteretic Modeling of Inter-Modular Connections for Volumetric CLT Buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Erica Fischer, Oregon State University (oregonstate.edu). This project provides supplemental material for the study “Experimental Characterization and Hysteretic Modeling of Inter-Modular Connections for Volumetric CLT Buildings.” The project documents the geometry and test setups used to characterize inter-modular connections made with cross-laminated timber (CLT), including steel plate dimensions, nail-withdrawal tests, horizontal and vertical nail shear connection tests, and HCW connection tests. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-07yx-0n32. Keywords: Inter-modular connections, Volumetric CLT modular buildings, Nailed connections, Hilti HCW connections, Hysteretic material. Published 2026-09-02. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
